description.en: Recognition, skills, tools, affordable credit, digital-payment incentives, and marketing support for artisans and craftspeople working in notified traditional trades.

benefit_summary.en: Benefits include a certificate and ID card, skill training with stipend, a toolkit incentive up to Rs 15,000, and collateral-free enterprise-development loans up to Rs 3 lakh in two tranches at the scheme's concessional interest rate, subject to its conditions.

eligibility_summary.en: An adult artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the notified family-based traditional trades may register. Registration and local verification determine final inclusion and access to each benefit.

name.en: Family and traditional-trade details requested during registration

instruction.en: Register through the official PM Vishwakarma process or an authorised Common Service Centre.
Complete the prescribed local verification and skill assessment or training stages.
Use only the benefit or credit stage for which the portal confirms eligibility.

citation.publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
